record.original_question: Let M be a Kähler manifold. Assume that all curvatures are between −a2 and −b2 . Construct nontrivial bounded holomorphic functions on M.

evidence.quote: Problem 11.3.1 Let M be a Kähler manifold. Assume that all curvatures are between −a2 and −b2 . Construct nontrivial bounded holomorphic functions on M. -N. Sibony, sibony@anh.matups.fr CR manifolds 12.1 Embedding

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M, g)$ be a complete Kähler manifold whose sectional curvatures $K$ satisfy
$$-a^2 \le K \le -b^2$$
everywhere, for some constants $a \ge b > 0$. Construct nontrivial bounded holomorphic functions on $M$. More precisely, exhibit a holomorphic function $f : M \to \mathbb{C}$ which is non-constant and satisfies $\sup_{p \in M} |f(p)| < \infty$, and ideally produce a family of such functions that separates points of $M$ and gives local holomorphic coordinates at every point.
artifact.category_tag: Bounded holomorphic functions on negatively curved Kähler manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: For simply-connected complete Kähler manifolds with sectional curvature pinched between two negative constants, work of Wu–Yau and subsequent results (e.g., the 2017 paper of Wu–Yau on invariant metrics on negatively pinched complete Kähler manifolds) shows that the Bergman metric is well-defined and uniformly equivalent to the background Kähler metric. This implies the existence of an abundance of bounded (indeed $L^2$) holomorphic functions separating points and giving local coordinates, thereby resolving Sibony's question affirmatively in the simply-connected case. In full generality (without simple connectivity, and only with sectional curvature bounds rather than holomorphic sectional curvature bounds), the construction of nontrivial bounded holomorphic functions is not fully settled.

status_evidence.title: Invariant metrics on negatively pinched complete Kähler manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Simply-connected complete Kähler manifold with sectional curvature bounded between two negative constants: Bergman, Kobayashi-Royden, Kähler-Einstein metrics are uniformly equivalent to the background metric.
status_evidence.claim: Implies existence of many bounded holomorphic functions on simply-connected pinched negatively curved Kähler manifolds.

status_evidence.title: On holomorphic functions on negatively curved manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies holomorphic functions on negatively curved Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent works continue to investigate the construction problem.

status_evidence.title: Weakly holomorphic homogeneous regular manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Simply connected Kähler manifolds with pinched negative sectional curvature belong to weakly holomorphic homogeneous regular manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent classifications place such manifolds in classes admitting many bounded holomorphic functions.
